exposure: Preservation media (dimethyl sulfoxide and enriched TC199)
outcome: Concentrations of epidermal growth factor, basic fibroblast growth factor, hepatocyte growth factor, keratinocyte growth factor, transforming growth factor-beta, and interleukins 4 and 10
cohort: Amniotic membrane samples from 8 women undergoing cesarean delivery
finding: Amniotic membrane storage at -80°C was optimal for maintaining the concentrations of most cytokines, and enriched TC199 medium was optimal for long-term storage, with most cytokine concentrations remaining stable for up to 1 to 7 days.
